name: Highland Park

cityHall.name: Highland Park Town Hall (Council Chamber/Court Room, 2nd floor)

council.structure: mayor + 5 council members, all elected at large
council.termNote: Mayor and council members are elected at large to two-year terms, limited to three successive terms (six years). Elections are held on the first Saturday in May of even-numbered years; the next is May 6, 2028. Mayor Pro Tem is Don Snell; other members are Leland White, Margaret Keliher, Alan Friedman and Mike Tibbals. Council-manager form of government.

meetings.label: Town Council Meeting

recurrence.notes: First and third Tuesday of each month at 8:00 a.m. Town calendar lists Sept 15, Oct 6, Oct 20, Nov 3 and Dec 1, 2026; Nov 17 and Dec 15 are not on the calendar (see scheduleExceptions).

meetings.location: Council Chamber/Court Room, 2nd floor, Town Hall, 4700 Drexel Dr, Highland Park, TX 75205
meetings.notes: Agendas and packets are posted three business days before each meeting on the website and on bulletin boards at Town Hall. No livestream was found on the official site.

meetings.label: Town Council Study Session

recurrence.notes: Begins immediately after the 8:00 a.m. regular meeting on the same day; the posted study session agenda is also stamped 8:00 AM.

meetings.location: Executive Conference Room, 2nd floor, Town Hall, 4700 Drexel Dr, Highland Park, TX 75205
meetings.notes: Staff operational updates, briefings on upcoming matters, future agenda discussion and any closed session. The study session agenda includes its own Public Comment section (3 minutes per speaker, agenda items only).

scheduleExceptions.note: No Town Council meeting is posted for the third Tuesday of November on the town calendar (only Nov 3 is listed). The 2025 calendar likewise showed only one November meeting (Nov 4), so the town appears to skip this date; confirm with the Town Secretary at 214-559-9457.

No Town Council meeting is posted for the third Tuesday of December on the town calendar (only Dec 1 is listed). The 2025 calendar likewise showed only one December meeting (Dec 2), so the town appears to skip this date; confirm with the Town Secretary at 214-559-9457.

agendaPortal.notes: Current agendas are PDFs in the CivicPlus Document Center linked from the Town Council Agendas page and from each calendar event (e.g., Sept 15: https://www.hptx.org/DocumentCenter/View/10215 and study session https://www.hptx.org/DocumentCenter/View/10214). A NovusAGENDA portal at https://highlandpark.novusagenda.com/agendapublic/ loads but showed no records during this check; the CivicPlus Agenda Center at https://www.hptx.org/agendacenter holds boards and committees.

publicComment.summary: Come to Town Hall at 8 a.m. on the first or third Tuesday and, when the Mayor opens the Public Comment section, you can speak for up to 3 minutes about any item on that day's agenda (comments on public hearings are taken during the hearing). There is no online sign-up; just be there and ask to be recognized, or contact the Town Secretary ahead of time.
publicComment.howToRegister: No online form or speaker card process is published. Attend in person and address the council during the Public Comment portion, or on a specific item before or during its consideration, upon being recognized by the presiding officer. For questions or to submit written material, contact Town Secretary Joanna Mekeal at townsecretary@hptx.org or 214-559-9457, or Town Hall administrative staff at 214-521-4161 (7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday through Friday).
publicComment.deadline: At the meeting, before or during the council's consideration of the item
publicComment.writtenCommentMethod: Email the Town Secretary at townsecretary@hptx.org (no formal written-comment channel is published)
publicComment.notes: Per the Sept 15, 2026 agenda, public comment is limited to items listed on the agenda; under the Texas Open Meetings Act the council cannot discuss or act on items not posted. The council may place suggested topics on a future agenda at its discretion. No remote participation option is published.

youthPrograms.name: IMPACT Committee
youthPrograms.ages: Highland Park residents in grades 9 through 12 at the start of the academic year
youthPrograms.description: An eight-month youth leadership program (up to 16 students) with seven school-year meetings plus orientation, lectures, discussion groups, site visits and volunteering that expose students to local government and give youth a voice in town services.
youthPrograms.applyWindow: Applications for the 2026-27 academic year were accepted until August 31, 2026 (closed for this cycle). Contacts: Joanna Mekeal, Town Secretary, 214-559-9457; Kortney Nelson, Town Librarian, 214-559-9404.

agendaItems.title: Wycliffe Avenue Reconstruction: construction contract plus owner's representative, inspection and construction-phase services (Consent IV.A-C)
agendaItems.summary: Authorizes the contracts needed to rebuild Wycliffe Avenue.

agendaItems.title: Eastern Avenue Reconstruction construction contract (Consent IV.D)
agendaItems.summary: Hires a contractor to rebuild Eastern Avenue.

agendaItems.title: Douglas Avenue Reconstruction construction contract (Consent IV.E)
agendaItems.summary: Hires a contractor to rebuild Douglas Avenue.

agendaItems.title: 2026 Drainage Easement Improvements construction contract (Consent IV.F)
agendaItems.summary: Funds work on drainage easements to reduce flooding in town neighborhoods.

agendaItems.title: Ordinance allowing civilian personnel to enforce parking rules (Consent IV.K)
agendaItems.summary: Changes the Town Code so non-officer staff can write parking tickets.

agendaItems.title: Public hearing and resolution amending the Master Fee Schedule effective Oct 1, 2026 (V.A)
agendaItems.summary: Residents can comment before the council adjusts fees for building permits, water, sewer, trash and stormwater.

agendaItems.title: Ordinance amending the FY 2025-26 adopted budget (VI.A)
agendaItems.summary: Makes end-of-year adjustments to the current town budget.

agendaItems.title: Ordinance authorizing TMRS cost-of-living adjustments and updated service credits effective Jan 1, 2027 (VI.B)
agendaItems.summary: Approves pension benefit updates for town employees and retirees through the Texas Municipal Retirement System.

agendaItems.title: Interlocal agreements with Dallas County for household hazardous waste, food inspections and health services (Consent IV.H-I)
agendaItems.summary: Renews county partnerships for hazardous waste drop-off, restaurant inspections and public health services.

agendaItems.title: Study session: update on the Zoning Ordinance Rewrite (III.A)
agendaItems.summary: Staff briefs the council on progress rewriting the town's zoning rules.

agendaItems.title: Study session: Park System Twenty-Year Strategy and funding approach (III.C)
agendaItems.summary: Council discusses a long-range plan for town parks and how to pay for it.

agendaItems.title: Study session: closed session with attorney on DART withdrawal and security devices (IV.A-B)
agendaItems.summary: Council meets privately about legal issues around leaving the DART transit system and about security equipment deployment.

notes: Re-verified Sept 10, 2026: schedule, address, term rules and public-comment rules come from hptx.org pages (Mayor & Town Council, Town Council Agendas, Municipal Elections, town calendar for Oct through Dec 2026) and the posted Sept 15, 2026 agenda PDFs, all fetched this session. The town publishes no online speaker registration and no livestream or video archive was found on the official site, so residents must attend in person. The town calendar shows only one council meeting each in November (Nov 3) and December (Dec 1) 2026, matching the 2025 pattern (Nov 4 and Dec 2 only); the third-Tuesday dates are listed as cancelled on that basis but are not explicitly labeled as such by the town. Population is the ACS 2024 5-year estimate (2020 Census: 8,853).
